comment_coopBattleStatusPlugin: Phase 14 (re the plugins entry above; comments inside the plugins map crash the loader, which instantiates every value as a class): the only mod code that runs inside a battle. Campaign EveryFrameScripts do not advance in the COMBAT state, so this EveryFrameCombatPlugin is what detects battle start, captures BATTLE_STATUS at 2.5 Hz, and flushes the outbound TCP queue while the pump is frozen. Inert unless a coop session is active (see CoopBattleBridge.onCombatFrame).
